title: Rodin's The Thinker jumps from $192,500 to $7.928m after 41 years off market
summary_full: The auction at Christie's on November 17 witnessed a remarkable highlight with the sale of Rodin's 1955 sculpture, Le Penseur, for a staggering $7.928 million, reflecting a dramatic price increase since its 1985 auction. This notable sculpture, which had not changed hands in 41 years, underscores the strong appetite for fine art in a week when total sales at Christie's neared $974 million.
